name: Lot Breakdown
definition: Number of securities purchased or sold in one transaction. In terms of options, a lot represents the number of contracts contained in one derivative security.

LotUnit.name: Lot Unit
LotUnit.definition: Quantity of securities included in the lot.

LotDateTime.name: Lot Date Time
LotDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the lot was purchased.

LotIdentifier.name: Lot Identifier
LotIdentifier.definition: Identifies the lot constituting an asset backed or mortgage backed security issue.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Number of securities included in a lot.

LotNumber.name: Lot Number
LotNumber.definition: Specifies the number of the lot.

LotPrice.name: Lot Price
LotPrice.definition: Specifies the price of the lot.

TradeLotMarket.name: Trade Lot Market
TradeLotMarket.definition: Market for which a trade lot is specified.

QuoteLotMarket.name: Quote Lot Market
QuoteLotMarket.definition: Market for which a quote lot is specified.

RoundLotMarket.name: Round Lot Market
RoundLotMarket.definition: Market for which a round lot size is specified.
